subject: Scope confirmation & onboarding checklist for annual assurance engagement
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@redshieldsec.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Marquez <elena@redshieldsec.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scope confirmation & onboarding checklist for annual assurance engagement

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached RedShield_SOW_v3.pdf with the updated scope for Redwood's annual assurance engagement (annual pen test + targeted red team for web and internal services). Highlights:

- Test windows: two production windows (non-overlapping) and a staging window; proposed dates in section 2.2.
- Evidence handoff: consolidated export (CSV + JSON) and per-finding packet; retention of raw logs for 90 days is in SOW.
- Remediation verification: 1 re-test for high / critical findings within 30 days.
- Dependencies: sandbox accounts, IP allowlist, and a short-lived service user with read-only access to logs (details in onboarding checklist).
- Pricing: fixed for base engagement, plus daily rates for additional scope changes.

Attachments: RedShield_SOW_v3.pdf, Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (checklist includes account names, API endpoints, and data classification notes).

Could you confirm the following so we can finalize the SOW and send the DocuSign envelope?
1) Acceptance of 90-day raw log retention (we can extend if needed).
2) Point of contact for evidence transfer and encrypted SFTP delivery.
3) Approx ETA for PO issuance (we need a PO before work starts per our procurement policy).

Happy to hop on a short call if you'd rather walk through the checklist together.

Best,

Samir Patel
Director, Assessments
RedShield Security
https://redshieldsec.com

---

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@redshieldsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope confirmation & onboarding checklist for annual assurance engagement

Samir —

Thanks for the SOW and checklist. Quick answers inline and a couple of requested edits before we sign: 

1) Retention: we'd like to increase raw log retention to 365 days for forensic support (section 3.1). Can you update the SOW to reflect that and include any storage cost delta?

2) Evidence transfer: our Security Ops mailbox is handled by Hannah Schmitt; please set the SFTP endpoint to the Redwood-managed bucket and we will provide a short-lived key. For immediate onboarding contact please use me and copy Hannah so we can coordinate access windows.

3) PO: Procurement will aim to issue the PO within 7 business days after DocuSign signature. Marissa — can you confirm procurement lead time and preferred invoice format?

4) Remediation verification window: 30 days is fine, but add an SLA clause that critical findings get a 72-hour initial response and a documented remediation plan within 5 business days.

5) Scope clarification: section 2.2 lists "internal services"; please enumerate the specific subnets and service names you expect to include so we can confirm exclusions (eg. customer PII vault is out of scope unless we approve).

If you can send a redline with the retention and SLA changes I will route to Marissa and Procurement and loop in Dylan for timeline coordination.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

- Retention: updated to 365 days; additional storage cost estimated at $1,200 for the engagement (line item in section 4.3).
- SLA: added 72-hour initial response for criticals and 5-business-day remediation plan requirement; added a remediation verification addendum.

We can host the evidence on an encrypted S3 bucket and share a short-lived KMS-wrapped key. For the SFTP option we can provide an SFTP endpoint if you prefer.
